request: Create a 10-second UGC product demo for this compact electronic gadget.
product_context: Small consumer-electronics device with fixed screen orientation, visible buttons, ports, cable connection, and one useful feature to demonstrate.
expected_behavior: Choose a problem-solution, feature-test, discovery, or desk-routine angle.
Keep the demonstrated feature tied to visible or supplied product facts.
Use activation or actual use as the hero moment.
critical_constraints: Preserve port, button, screen, cable, and device geometry.
Do not invent hidden functions or extra controls.
Keep cable orientation and device scale physically plausible.
failure_conditions: Ports or buttons move between shots.
The prompt invents a feature absent from supplied product context.
The device changes size or screen orientation.
